stories.title: Geheimdienstreform: Bundestag berät über mehr Befugnisse für die Geheimdienste

en.title: Intelligence reform: Bundestag discusses expanded powers for intelligence services
en.summary: Federal Interior Minister Dobrindt seeks to broaden measures against sabotage and espionage. The proposed new rights for intelligence agencies are causing controversy in the Bundestag.

stories.title: Polen: Polnische Regierung hält Brand in Starlink-Station für »Sabotage«

en.title: Poland: Polish government suspects arson at Starlink station
en.summary: Poland's government suspects sabotage following a fire at a satellite facility. The Starlink terminal affected also provides internet service to the Ukrainian military.

stories.title: Newsblog zur Bundespolitik: Bundestag berät über mögliche Neuregelung der Organspende

en.title: News blog on federal politics: Bundestag discusses possible new organ donation regulation
en.summary: A group of lawmakers has reintroduced an opt-out model for organ donation in the Bundestag. Under this system, all adults would automatically become donors unless they explicitly object.

stories.title: Deutsche Konjunktur: Wirtschaftsforscher verdoppeln ihre Wachstumsprognose

en.title: German Economy: Economic Researchers Double Their Growth Forecast
en.summary: Major German economic research institutes expect GDP growth of 1.3 percent this year and are calling on the state to increase savings, citing fiscal policy as being off track.

stories.title: Newsblog zum Ukraine-Krieg: Russland beschießt Kiew und die Region Charkiw: Tote und Verletzte

en.title: News Blog on Ukraine War: Russia Shells Kyiv and Kharkiv Region; Deaths and Injuries
en.summary: Russian forces attacked agricultural facilities in Kharkiv region and struck Kyiv with heavy explosions, forcing residents to seek shelter from air raids.

en.title: Economy: Economic Researchers Double Growth Forecast for 2026
en.summary: Leading economic research institutes have doubled their growth forecast for 2026 in their autumn assessment, though growth is expected to decline thereafter.

en.title: Heat Weakens Europe's Economic Performance
en.summary: Extreme heat is projected to cost the European economy 113 billion euros this year, with Germany particularly affected, prompting warnings about rising climate-related damages.

stories.title: US-Gericht hebt vorerst Trumps Ausschluss von US-Medien auf

en.title: US Court Temporarily Lifts Trump's Exclusion of US Media
en.summary: A US court has temporarily suspended President Trump's ban on journalists from accessing the White House, determining the exclusion likely violates the Constitution.

stories.title: Gegen CNN und Politico: US-Richter hebt Trumps Medien-Bann auf

en.title: US Judge Lifts Trump's Media Ban Against CNN and Politico
en.summary: A federal judge ordered the White House to lift a ban on journalists from CNN, MSNBC, and Politico and immediately restore their access.

stories.title: Gericht hebt Ausschluss von Medien aus Weißem Haus vorerst auf

en.title: Court Temporarily Lifts Media Exclusion from White House
en.summary: A US court has temporarily lifted President Trump's ban on journalists from the White House, with a Trump-appointed judge ruling the exclusion likely unconstitutional.

stories.title: USA-Newsblog: Richter hebt Trumps Ausschluss von US-Medien vorerst auf

en.title: USA News Blog: Judge Temporarily Lifts Trump's Exclusion of US Media
en.summary: A judge has ruled that the US government must restore press access to the White House for journalists from CNN, MSNBC, and Politico, calling the exclusion likely unconstitutional.

stories.title: Interview: Berenberg-Sonderbeauftragter Peters: „Ich bin dankbar für das Eingreifen der Aufsicht“

en.title: Interview: Berenberg Special Representative Peters: "I am grateful for regulatory intervention"
en.summary: The interim chief of the bank reports progress in cleanup efforts following an accounting scandal, with new leadership potentially being announced next week. The affair continues to have lasting impacts on the institution.

stories.title: Anleihemarkt: Druck auf Bessent steigt: Ausverkauf bei US-Anleihen erfasst den gesamten Bondmarkt

en.title: Bond market: Pressure on Bessent rises: US Treasury selloff sweeps across entire bond market
en.summary: Weak demand at a US Treasury auction and increasing concerns about the Federal Reserve's tighter interest rate path have driven bond yields to new year-to-date highs.

stories.title: Dax aktuell: Dax notiert trotz starker Konjunkturaussichten im Minus

en.title: Dax today: Dax falls despite strong economic outlook
en.summary: High oil prices, rising bond yields, and geopolitical uncertainty are weighing on markets, preventing a strong Ifo business climate index from lifting investor sentiment.

stories.title: Kommentar: Deutschlands Forschung ist ein Selbstbedienungsladen für China

en.title: Commentary: Germany's research is a self-service shop for China
en.summary: The case of the Helmholtz Center Cispa reveals gaps in the protection of sensitive research, raising questions about whether Germany's scientific institutions handle intellectual property too carelessly.
